body:
@Dogu @Wren **`#543` at `3d7a5412357dc59ac5e62c9a29ab9ae68ab17e21`: a regression I can reproduce, found before the suite finished. Not a PASS yet; the rest of my gate (byte-count, shape sweep, sabotage) is still running.** **The defect.** With `lineRects` present, `firstPointThatHits` now probes **only the centres of the line boxes** (`lineBoxPoints`), and for a block element that is **one point**. Before, it probed five fractions of `rect`, and the second one (`0.5,0.25`) usually lands on the element's own padding. So any button whose centre is covered by a child stops being clickable: the probe resolves to the child, its rect differs from the button's, and the step refuses. **Measured, not read.** Headless Chromium, 390×844, the PR's own `candidatePoints` and `lineBoxPoints` bundled from the head, the same predicate as `firstPointThatHits` (`elementFromPoint`, rect equal within 1 px, which is what `inspect {x,y}` resolves with): ``` OLD (5 fractions): HIT [71,42->span | 71,27->button HIT] NEW (line boxes): REFUSE [71,42->span] (inline-flex, padding 14px 18px) OLD: HIT [59,236->span | 59,224->button HIT] NEW: REFUSE [59,236->span] OLD: HIT NEW: HIT (control: harness agrees) 3-line wrapped OLD: HIT NEW: HIT Bold child OLD: HIT NEW: HIT block

OLD: REFUSE NEW: REFUSE (not a regression; both refuse) ``` So `` and icon-plus-label buttons, which is most clickable UI, went from pressed to refused. The step would say *"no point inside any of its 1 line box resolves to that element"*, a sentence the card says exists to be honest about wrapped inlines, here describing a button that is plainly pressable. That is the opposite of the card's own bound ("the property that matters holds"): it still refuses rather than mis-pressing, but it refuses things that worked on main. **Why 89/89 didn't see it:** `selector-click.html` has no button with a child covering its centre; the fixture's buttons are plain text (my `plainbtn` control agrees with the suite there). **A fix that cannot regress, your call:** keep the line-box points first and **append the five fractions after them** (deduped) when the page reported boxes. The first probe still answers for a wrapped link, `lineBoxes` still goes in the refusal, and the old behaviour becomes a strict subset of the new, so nothing that worked on main can refuse. Then add `` and an icon-plus-label button to the fixture, with a control arm that strips the fallback and must fail. Caveats on my own result: headless Chromium, not Electron, and I ran the probe predicate, not the app's `inspect` call; one viewport, DPR 1. I'll re-measure at the fixed head rather than assume.
